interpretation.control: Recorded complete model pairs and same reachable execution adapter are present in every audited legal collection; issued/applied and expert label chains checked
interpretation.projection: Projection frequency/magnitude describes active command constraints; not physical tracking speed or proof of failure cause
interpretation.saturation: abs(tanh fraction)>=0.95 on student prefixes; separate from projection or expert required-bound overflow
interpretation.delay: Recorded actual issued/applied chain is equal and existing expert queue flush/mask audited; no additional student delay observed; task effect of native delay unisolated
interpretation.autonomous_rate_reason: Scheduled-takeover prefixes do not measure complete autonomous policy success
interpretation.stable_grasp_prefix_diagnostic: not recomputed; whole-trajectory contact diagnostics include expert suffix
interpretation.causal_improvement: unknown until current trained pair autonomous evaluation; no same-state old/new full rollout comparison

unmeasured.student_prefix_required_expert_residual_: Not measured: existing dagger_required_expert_residual_out_of_bounds is deliberately zero-filled outside expert execution; its zeros cannot establish that student-required corrections are in bounds.
unmeasured.student_prefix_stable_grasp: Not recomputed; whole-trajectory contact summary includes expert-controlled suffix and is unsuitable for this student-prefix statistic.
unmeasured.delay_causal_effect: Issued/applied alignment and label-validity checks pass, but these traces alone cannot establish whether delay causes task failure.
unmeasured.autonomous_task_success: Scheduled expert takeover censors each student prefix; these are not full autonomous evaluations.

metric_definitions.projection: abs(execution_projection_rad) > 1e-6 rad; joint fractions use all 29 student-controlled dimensions per tick.
metric_definitions.target_slew: Difference between actual actuator targets divided by control dt; not measured joint velocity.
metric_definitions.takeover_phase: Native observations through student prefix, ordered lift, contact gate, otherwise noncontact; descriptive coverage, not task stage ground truth.
